🗓️ Another day, another real SQL interview question – continuing my series of practical SQL challenges I’ve come across during GCP Data Engineer interviews.


🔶 Question 5: Sales Difference Month Over Month

You’re given a table with monthly sales data.
Your task is to add a column that shows the difference between the current month’s sales and the previous month’s sales for each product.

🧾 Input Table: monthly_sales

| product_id | month | sales |
|------------|-----------|-------|
| A | January | 100 |
| A | February | 130 |
| A | March | 120 |
| B | January | 80 |
| B | February | 70 |
| B | March | 90 |


✅ Expected Output:

| product_id | month | sales | sales_diff 
|------------|-----------|-------|------------|
| A | January | 100 | NULL 
| A | February | 130 | 30 
| A | March | 120 | -10 
| B | January | 80 | NULL 
| B | February | 70 | -10 
| B | March | 90 | 20 

📌 Use SQL window functions or any logic that works — just make sure it handles multiple products properly.
